title: Glass
description: pen.dev liquid glass as a wrapper. Exact glass.glsl. Defaults from the glass circle.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { GLASS_DEFAULTS, type GlassSettings } from "./defaults" import { useGlassRuntime } from "./use-glass" export type GlassProps = React.ComponentProps<"div"> & Partial export { GLASS_DEFAULTS } from "./defaults" export function Glass({ className, children, ior = GLASS_DEFAULTS.ior, chromatic = GLASS_DEFAULTS.chromatic, edgeWidth = GLASS_DEFAULTS.edgeWidth, specPower = GLASS_DEFAULTS.specPower, specIntensity = GLASS_DEFAULTS.specIntensity, fresnelIntensity = GLASS_DEFAULTS.fresnelIntensity, blur = GLASS_DEFAULTS.blur, split = GLASS_DEFAULTS.split, splitAngle = GLASS_DEFAULTS.splitAngle, falloff = GLASS_DEFAULTS.falloff, ...props }: GlassProps) { const rootRef = React.useRef(null) const canvasRef = React.useRef(null) const settings = { ior, chromatic, edgeWidth, specPower, specIntensity, fresnelIntensity, blur, split, splitAngle, falloff, } useGlassRuntime(rootRef, canvasRef, settings) return (
{children != null ?
{children}
: null}
) }

export const GLASS_DEFAULTS = {
  ior: 2,
  chromatic: 0.13,
  edgeWidth: 200,
  specPower: 55.61,
  specIntensity: 0.96,
  fresnelIntensity: 1.2,
  blur: 1.2,
  split: 0.45,
  splitAngle: 130,
  falloff: 168,
} as const

export const GLASS_TEXT_DEFAULTS = {
  ior: 1.42,
  chromatic: 0.155,
  edgeWidth: 42,
  specPower: 15,
  specIntensity: 0.52,
  fresnelIntensity: 0.95,
  blur: 0.85,
  split: 0.26,
  splitAngle: 145,
  falloff: 255,
} as const

export type GlassSettings = {
  [K in keyof typeof GLASS_DEFAULTS]: number
}

export type GlassUniforms = {
  u_ior: number
  u_chromatic: number
  u_edgeWidth: number
  u_specPower: number
  u_specIntensity: number
  u_fresnelIntensity: number
  u_blur: number
  u_split: number
  u_splitAngle: number
  u_falloff: number
}

export function glassUniforms(
  overrides: Partial<GlassSettings> = {}
): GlassUniforms {
  const settings = { ...GLASS_DEFAULTS, ...overrides }
  return {
    u_ior: settings.ior,
    u_chromatic: settings.chromatic,
    u_edgeWidth: settings.edgeWidth,
    u_specPower: settings.specPower,
    u_specIntensity: settings.specIntensity,
    u_fresnelIntensity: settings.fresnelIntensity,
    u_blur: settings.blur,
    u_split: settings.split,
    u_splitAngle: settings.splitAngle,
    u_falloff: settings.falloff,
  }
}
